sections.title: Data & AI
sections.subtitle: From AI strategy to agentic AI in production: turn data into decisions, governed from day one.

sections.heading: A practical path from data to decisions
sections.body:
Connect AI readiness and use-case priorities with the data foundations, evaluation and deployment work they require. Define human oversight, governance controls and operational ownership before introducing AI into enterprise workflows.

Predictive machine learning supports scoring and forecasting; GenAI and agents support knowledge and task execution. [Discuss your business task, available data and governance constraints](#get-in-touch), or explore the product pages for a software enquiry.

sections.heading: Data & AI services
sections.description: Choose the specialist service that fits your next decision.

items.title: AI strategy & governance
items.description: Prioritise roadmaps, use cases and business value. Define guardrails, cost controls, observability and responsibility for AI decisions.

items.title: Agentic AI & GenAI
items.description: Knowledge assistants and task-executing agents on enterprise data, with evaluation and guardrails. Connect GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to specific business tasks.

items.title: Data platforms & analytics
items.description: Build the platforms and pipelines that organise enterprise data. Deliver Power BI analytics and a foundation for reporting, predictive dashboards and AI use cases.

items.title: Machine learning
items.description: Apply prediction, scoring and forecasting to business decisions. Evaluate models for churn, demand, fraud, anomalies and loan-default risk against an agreed baseline.

sections.heading: Put governed intelligence *to work*
sections.description: Data & AI contributes use-case prioritisation, data readiness, evaluation and oversight. Digital Transformation and Cyber Security provide engineering and code-assurance components.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Teams need usable intelligence within processes, not disconnected AI experiments.
plays.outcome: Start with a task, data and control map. Add evaluated AI orchestration to workflows and measure adoption and process performance.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-enabled development needs defined evaluation and accountable acceptance.
plays.outcome: Start with evaluation criteria for AI-written change. Combine data and AI governance with engineering and security assurance gates.

sections.heading: From AI use case to governed operation
sections.description: Illustrative engagement pattern: agree scope, owners and acceptance criteria before delivery.

items.title: Prioritise and govern
items.description: Define the business task, available data, risk constraints and decision owner. Agree evaluation and human-oversight criteria.

items.title: Prepare, build and evaluate
items.description: Prepare data, build the model or agent workflow and test it against the agreed baseline. Review failure cases and access controls.

items.title: Deploy, measure and operate
items.description: Agree production acceptance, monitoring, escalation and operational ownership. Measure adoption and business relevance after deployment.

sections.note: Agree data sources, evaluation criteria, failure cases, human-review rules and permitted agent actions. Establish deployment, access, monitoring and cost responsibilities before acceptance.
